codeRelationship.finding: The codes describe closely matching MT-09 service-manual identities, but no Yamaha-controlled record found in the bounded check maps B7N-28197-E0 to LIT-11616-34-61 or establishes common EU/USA content.

model.finding: Official LIT metadata explicitly includes MT-09 and MT-09 SP; mirror-only B7N metadata names MTN890 and MTN890D. The B7N identity is not officially linked to the target.

generation.finding: The repository maps MY2021 MTN890 to MT-09 III, but the official LIT route does not expose an EU generation mapping.

year.finding: Official Yamaha metadata registers LIT-11616-34-61 for MY2021; this does not prove MY2021 EU applicability for B7N-28197-E0.

euMarket.finding: No Yamaha-controlled EU publication listing or delivery path for B7N-28197-E0 was authenticated.

northAmericaMarket.finding: Yamaha Motor Corporation U.S.A. identifies LIT-11616-34-61 for 2021-and-newer MT-09 and 2021 MT-09 SP.

standard.finding: The official LIT identity explicitly includes standard MT-09.

sp.finding: The official LIT identity explicitly includes MT-09 SP.

standardSpSeparable.finding: Metadata proves both models are included but does not prove safety-critical sections can be separated without content inspection.

abs.finding: Metadata does not establish ABS applicability or separability for future brake/wheel extraction.

transmission.finding: The selected catalogue target is manual, but the service-publication metadata does not independently state transmission scope.

equipment.finding: Standard/SP and regional equipment boundaries are not resolved strongly enough for safety-critical extraction.

prospect.overlapAssessment: Fresh complementary service-manual class with likely overlap; only the 15 remaining Service Core slots are marginal, and no value-level yield was inspected.
